scope: Change SF internal floors and oldest Office/School only; preserve MF, Generic and all envelope/renovation layers. One representative per cell.
cavity_method: Sealed high-emissivity air gap; conservative upward-flow effective resistance held fixed for nominal bidirectional model. Depth-specific lambda=d/R; equivalent layer is not a solid insulation product. Area-weighted conductivity in each joist sublayer remains EPSM approximation, not full 2D ISO 6946 or dynamic cavity simulation.

evidence_limits.historical_institutional: Wood/sand family supported by City Hall extraction record 293. 100 mm sand, 98 mm cavity, 22 mm support boards and 220 mm joists are explicit engineering selections, not extracted dimensions or a national prevalence claim. School is a declared historical analogy. The 0.37/2.90 source conflict is excluded from fitting.
evidence_limits.historical_sf: Retain shavings material from supplied historic SF family, reduce to 100 mm with a supported blind floor and residual cavity. Fill depth is a representative assumption; extraction does not establish national prevalence.
evidence_limits.modern_sf: 70 mm comfort insulation informed by TräGuiden 50-70 mm example; 220 mm joists and 15% framing are representative assumptions. Full-depth perimeter insulation is a separate junction issue. No acoustic, fire or structural compliance certification.

sand_thermal_proxy.conductivity_basis: extraction record 148 dry sand; transferred to historic fill
sand_thermal_proxy.density_and_cp_basis: Engineering proxy informed by dry sandy soil table in FHWA research report; not measured City Hall fill

carbon_scope: Retained sand has no suitable resource in pinned Boverket 02.07.000; leave mapping pending and carbon readiness false. LoD2 accepts this only when the explicit retained-floor declaration is verified against identical floors in all three states and absence elsewhere. Incoming renovation materials still require mappings.
acceptance: Nominal physical and export acceptance; empirical EPC validation pending. No numerical smoothing or imposed age trend.
